title: Staff Software Engineer - Databases
description: P-375 Staff Software Engineer (L6) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of our global platform that manages schema and data changes at scale. You will architect automated infrastructure for safe, predictable migrations across thousands of databases, build robust test harnesses to validate deployments, and create developer-friendly tools that make complex operations simple and reliable. Your work will directly impact the scalability, reliability, and velocity of Databricks' global platform. The Impact You Will Have - Lead the design and implementation of automated schema migration infrastructure for MySQL and TiDB, including versioning, rollback, validation, and auditing capabilities - Ensure platform reliability and zero-downtime operations across thousands of global databases through enhanced resilience, observability, and recovery mechanisms - Build comprehensive test harnesses to validate migrations and deployments, enabling predictable and safe schema changes at scale - Design and implement infrastructure for large-scale data operations including backfills and purging, with monitoring, retry logic, and minimal disruption - Create intuitive developer tools and APIs that simplify schema and data change management - Integrate migration workflows into CI/CD pipelines to increase deployment velocity and reduce operational friction - Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for database platform infrastructure What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments - Strong background in platform engineering, infrastructure development, or database systems - Experience with relational databases including MySQL or similar technologies - Track record of leading complex technical projects that span multiple systems or teams - Experience designing schema migration frameworks, CI/CD automation, or developer tooling - Ability to balance technical complexity with developer experience, creating reliable and user-friendly workflows - Strong problem-solving skills with focus on scalability, reliability, and operational excellence - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
